doc: pdfattach - Portable Document Format (PDF) document embedded file creator (version 3.03)
Pdfattach adds a new embedded file (attachment) to an existing Portable Document Format (PDF) file.

-replace
Replace embedded file with same name (if it exists)
-v
Print copyright and version information.
-h
Print usage information. (-help and --help are equivalent.)

<dl><dt>0</dt><dd>No error.</dd><dt>1</dt><dd>Error opening input PDF file.</dd><dt>2</dt><dd>Error opening file to attach.</dd><dt>3</dt><dd>Output file already exists.</dd><dt>3</dt><dd>There is already an attached file with that name.</dd><dt>5</dt><dd>Error saving the output file.</dd></dl>
